result.instructions: Pinned runs coding agents on the user's own machines. Call list_projects first: you may only work in the projects listed there. Sessions ask the user before risky actions; when a session reports needs_permission or waiting_for_input, tell the user to answer it in Pinned. Never retry a start or a message with a new request_id unless read_session shows it did not happen.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The projects the user let you work in, each with its id, name, machine and whether that machine is online.

tools.name: start_session
tools.title: Start a coding session
tools.description: Start a new coding agent session in a project with a task. It runs on the user's machine with the user's own permission settings: it asks the user before risky actions and you can't answer those prompts. Returns a session_id for read_session and send_message.

task.description: The whole assignment: the goal, the constraints, and how to verify the result.

title.description: A few words naming the session.

request_id.description: A key you make up for this one request, such as a UUID. Sending the same request_id again answers what the first call did and never acts twice. A new request needs a new request_id.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Message a session
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to a session you started. Refused while the session is starting, working or waiting on the user, so it never answers a prompt meant for the user; read_session says when it may take a message (done or failed).

request_id.description: A key you make up for this one request, such as a UUID. Sending the same request_id again answers what the first call did and never acts twice. A new request needs a new request_id.

tools.name: read_session
tools.title: Read a session
tools.description: A session's state and its latest conversation. state is starting, working, done, failed, needs_permission, waiting_for_input, ended, offline or not_found. needs_permission and waiting_for_input mean the user has to answer in Pinned.

cursor.description: The cursor the last read returned, to get only what came after it.

limit.description: At most this many conversation items, the latest; 20 when left out, 100 at most.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: The sessions you started, newest first, with their state.

tools.name: message_orchestrator
tools.title: Message the project's orchestrator
tools.description: Send a message to the project's orchestrator, the agent that plans the project's work and delegates it to worker sessions. When it isn't running this starts it and delivers nothing yet: send the message again with the same request_id once read_orchestrator says done. Refused while the orchestrator is starting, working or waiting on the user.

request_id.description: A key you make up for this one request, such as a UUID. Sending the same request_id again answers what the first call did and never acts twice. A new request needs a new request_id.

tools.name: read_orchestrator
tools.title: Read the project's orchestrator
tools.description: The orchestrator's state and its latest conversation, with the same states as read_session, plus not_started.

cursor.description: The cursor the last read returned, to get only what came after it.

limit.description: At most this many conversation items, the latest; 20 when left out, 100 at most.
